BTC-BRL._comment_profile: inherit the live working profile; the manager only drives tilt + substitution, never rewrites proven spreads/TP/eff

convergence._comment: EXPLOIT target = the LIVE winner's config (ranked by capital-normalized yield). NEVER a backtest winner (backtest != live).

substitution._comment: persistent losers get their CONFIG replaced; patience window + churn cap so we don't churn on noise

replacement_pool._comment_exploit: most replacements -> the LIVE winner's config = the fleet converges (at config level) to what works live
replacement_pool._comment_explore: ~a couple of slots -> a fresh backtest candidate; must PROVE OUT LIVE before it's trusted as an exploit target

bench._comment: continuous chunked backtest on brigado (read-only) feeds the EXPLORE pool only

risk._comment: 3 tiers, softest -> hardest: substitution  <  brake  <  global_kill

brake._comment: gradual de-risk: LOWER target_base_pct on drawdown/drift. NEVER market-sells (that is selling the bottom).

global_kill._comment: catastrophe backstop ONLY: max cumulative fleet loss -> HALT new quoting + ALERT you. Does NOT dump inventory.
global_kill._comment_tune: SET your maximum tolerable fleet loss in BRL. null = disabled until you set it.
